title: Find spaCR on GitHub, PyPI and conda-forge
description: Find the official package, container image and installer sources, compare the release available on each channel, and choose the matching installation tutorial.
objectives: Choose the installation route for your computer.
prerequisite: Open a web browser and decide whether you want a desktop installer or a Python environment.

scenes.narration: Choose how you want to install spaCR. A desktop installer gives a ready-to-launch application. Pip installs into a Python virtual environment, conda-forge installs into a Conda environment, and Docker runs the command-line pipelines in a container. Start from the official spaCR links shown here.

On PyPI, find spaCR and read the installation command beside the current release. Copy that command when you are ready to install into your Python environment. Install spaCR shows how to create and activate that environment first.
Use Project links to open the documentation, source repository or issue tracker. Bookmark the documentation so you can return to the module walkthroughs while working in spaCR.
On GitHub, open the spaCR repository. Main contains the release source, and nightly contains the latest development work. For a packaged desktop installation, open Releases and choose a release.
Expand Assets and download the installer for Windows, macOS or Linux. The Platform installers lesson explains installation, launching spaCR and uninstalling it on each operating system.

For containers, open Packages from the spaCR repository and select the spaCR container package. Each release tag has a CPU image and a matching CUDA image. Install spaCR explains how to pull, check and run the exact tag you select.
On conda-forge, open the spaCR package page and check the available version. Package channels can update at different times, so select the version available through the route you choose.

The conda-forge command installs spaCR into your active Conda environment. Follow Install spaCR to create that environment, install the package and launch the application. That lesson also explains package and environment removal.

Continue with Install spaCR for pip, conda-forge or Docker, or Platform installers for a desktop installer. Both lessons include uninstall guidance. Once spaCR opens, move to Home, then the pipeline overviews to choose a workflow for your data.
